svg:text.svg:tspan: General Entry Requirements
Five GCSEs at grade 9 to 4 including English (Literature or
Language). If a student has not studied a subject at GCSE this
does not preclude them from studying it at A Level. Students who
do not meet the minimum requirements to study in the Sixth
Form or who do not meet subject speciÄc requirements will still
be considered in light of their suitability to study their chosen
options.
